_note: PLACEHOLDER unlocks and mote costs (design-brief-v0 flags the whole v0 node set as placeholder). These three are the Reality layer's entire v0 content. The third node's payoff only matters after a base reset — which is Q-C in open-questions.md and NOT to be resolved in code. CUT 7 Aug (fossil-audit): 'extra_symbol_slot' granted a book slot, and books stopped having symbol slots when the page grid replaced them — `bonusBookSlots` was read by nothing even before that. 'essence_head_start' pays out after a reset, and there is no reset; it comes back when one exists, rather than taking three motes for an event the game cannot produce. A node that grants a value nothing consumes is a fossil by definition, and EconomyTests now asserts against it. 7 Aug (fossil-audit §3): 'The Long Instruction' said '+1 gambit slot for your companion' and was written when there was one companion; there is a roster of five now, and a Reality-layer permanent applies to all of them — which is the obvious reading and much more valuable, so THREE MOTES IS PROBABLY UNDERPRICED. Aimee's call; the cost is here and nowhere else. Slot count is per person now, because Wit governs rule length (session 17 §1) and CharacterRules.gambitSlots was read by nothing until it had somebody to be about.
